400.description: Invalid input, incompatible module or referenced module

429.description: Upload or self-test rate limit reached

description: Raw binary upload, at most 16 MiB. Compiles and inspects HTTP ABI imports/exports without instantiating. Host activation additionally runs the exact configured module in an isolated Nginx process. Only administrators may introduce executable modules. Bytecode and module metadata are immutable and addressed by SHA-256.
